module_summary: 8-bit logical right barrel shifter: three cascaded stages of 2:1 muxes shift by 4, 2 and 1, each selected by one ctrl bit.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Final shifted result from the shift-by-1 mux stage

anchors.name: ctrl
anchors.why: Shift amount; each bit selects one mux stage (4, 2, 1)

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Output of shift-by-4 stage feeding shift-by-2 stage

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Output of shift-by-2 stage feeding shift-by-1 stage

groups.name: shift4_stage
groups.description: Eight muxes shifting input right by 4 when ctrl[2]

groups.name: shift2_stage
groups.description: Eight muxes shifting x right by 2 when ctrl[1]

groups.name: shift1_stage
groups.description: Eight muxes shifting y right by 1 when ctrl[0]
